# Plastic Electrical Hardware & Wiring Accessories Manufacturer in Malaysia

About Us

## meet rb diversified

Welcome to RB Diversified Sdn Bhd, your number one source for plastic electrical hardware and wiring accessories. We’re dedicated to supply our customer with products with the focus of “Quality & Reliable”.

RB Diversified Sdn Bhd was incorporated in year 2015 and setup new factory located at Batu Arang, Selangor in 2018 to meet the growing demand to our product from West and East Malaysia Market. We’re currently equipped with our own tools room and R&D facilities for product development. We also have our own mould making and manufacturing plant to fulfil different customer needs.

Our founders, Mr. HS Goh and Mr. FC Wong are experienced plastic injection mould maker since 1993, and then developed to plastic electrical hardware manufacturing since 1997. Our company provides a full spectrum of work of any level of complexity. Our team consists of highly qualified professionals, who have been in the industry for no less than 30 years. We have gained extensive experience while solving the most complex technical and organizational tasks, what allows us to provide you with the best products.
